rainbow trout with high growth capacity can increase white muscle P/l ratio levels and digestive enzyme activities if they are fed on a HP-diet, while fish with medium and low growth capacities are limited by the digestive capacity.

the growth capacity of fish was related to the digestive efficiency and the P/L ratio in the white muscle, and the growth capacity was related to the growth of skeletal length and not the growth of body weight.

the P/L ratio of rainbow trout diets can be adjusted during growth and maturation.
the growth capacity of fish can be improved by increasing dietary protein levels, but this may not be a good strategy for all fish.
